scenario: You are working at the university library. Your supervisor is explaining how the circulation desk works. Listen to the supervisor and repeat what the supervisor says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Students need their ID card to borrow books.
Most books can be kept for three full weeks.
Reference books have to stay inside the library at all times.
If a book is overdue, the system will add a small fine.
You'll scan the barcode on the back cover before you stamp it.
When someone wants a book that's already checked out, help them place a hold online.
